component.name: taskmaster-pro
component.description: Ultimate todo & productivity suite built on Cloudflare Workers, Hono and SQLite Durable Objects.

properties.name: sbom-scope
properties.value: runtime + build-time dependencies; browser assets are bundled at build time, so only Google Fonts still loads from a CDN

components.name: hono
components.integrity: pinned in package.json, resolved by lockfile

components.name: react
components.delivery: npm (bundled into public/assets/app.js by esbuild at build time)
components.integrity: pinned in package.json (^18.3.1); no lockfile is committed, so CI resolves fresh

properties.name: risk
properties.value: low - bundled locally, so no third-party script executes at page view

components.name: react-dom
components.delivery: npm (bundled into public/assets/app.js by esbuild at build time)

components.name: react/jsx-runtime
components.delivery: npm (resolved from the react package; esbuild --jsx=automatic emits the imports)

properties.name: role
properties.value: automatic JSX runtime emitted by esbuild

properties.name: risk
properties.value: low - resolved from npm, never fetched in the browser

properties.name: note
properties.value: Was the classic blank-page trap: the importmap entry had to be exactly right or React rendered nothing. Resolved by the bundler now, so that failure mode is gone.

components.name: lucide-react
components.delivery: npm (bundled into public/assets/app.js; unused icons tree-shaken)

properties.name: role
properties.value: icon set (30 imported; esbuild drops the unused ones)

components.name: esbuild
components.delivery: npm devDependency (build-time only; never shipped to the browser)

properties.name: role
properties.value: compiles src/app.jsx into public/assets/app.js - JSX transform, bundling, minification

properties.name: risk
properties.value: low - build-time only, so nothing it runs executes with page privilege

properties.name: note
properties.value: Replaces DEP-006 (@babel/standalone), which transpiled JSX in the browser on every page load. A compromised esbuild could tamper with the bundle at build time, so the version is pinned and CI runs a bundle check before any deploy.

components.name: tailwindcss
components.delivery: npm devDependency (build-time only; compiles src/tailwind.css into public/assets/app.css)

properties.name: role
properties.value: utility CSS framework, compiled ahead of time instead of JIT'd in the browser

properties.name: remediation-applied
properties.value: Moved off the Play CDN on 2026-10-17 to the npm package, driven by tailwind.config.cjs. Tailwind 4 stays rejected: CSS-first config, drops the tailwind.config file format this app uses.

properties.name: note
properties.value: Previously a CDN script tag, which the vendor explicitly marks as not-for-production. The build-time package was the correct end state.

properties.name: risk
properties.value: low - but loads external CSS; also blocked in EU/GDPR contexts by default

components.name: cloudflare:workers
components.delivery: platform-provided ESM external, resolved at runtime

properties.name: note
properties.value: Not a package; listed for completeness. Cannot be added to package.json per platform rules.

summary.note: The build step landed 2026-10-17 (COMP-017) and removed six CDN runtime dependencies in one move: @babel/standalone (DEP-006) is gone entirely, tailwindcss (DEP-007) moved off the Play CDN onto npm, and react, react-dom, react/jsx-runtime and lucide-react (DEP-002..005) moved off esm.sh onto npm and are bundled into public/assets/app.js. Nothing third-party executes at page view any more. The only remaining CDN loads are Google Fonts (DEP-008, DEP-009), which carry no SRI and are blocked in some privacy regimes - self-hosting those woff2 files is the remaining move. npmBundled counts the six npm packages (react/jsx-runtime ships inside the react package). withSRI is now 0 because there is no CDN script tag left that could accept an integrity attribute.
